summary: Misfit Improv & Acting School is a commercial improv/acting school in Asheville founded by Gillian Bellinger, offering paid tiered classes, corporate workshops, and coaching, plus free community outreach events including a quarterly 'Jam Jam' drop-in improv night. The Jam Jam itself is an open, name-drawn-from-a-bucket format explicitly welcoming newcomers and spectators, not a fixed roster of returning players.

evidence.note: Listing describes a 'sign up and play' format: names go in a bucket and are drawn to perform, explicitly open to 'all levels', newcomers, and spectators who just want to watch.
Held quarterly (Feb/May/Aug/Oct 2026) at Dr. Wesley Grant Sr. Southside Community Center, a public community venue, not the school's own studio.

Home page frames Misfit as an improv and acting school with tiered paid classes, corporate workshops and individual coaching, run by artistic director Gillian Bellinger; no page section describes the Jam Jam or names any returning jam regulars.
Search results show a dedicated classes page (misfitimprov.com/classes) listing structured, paid course offerings (e.g. Long Form 201, Music Improv Level 1), reinforcing the business/school model.
Facebook page is titled 'Misfit Improv & Acting School', consistent with a business identity rather than a member-run club or collective.
